evidence: S1: code 1333 starts with closed-shell electron pairs. Repository S3 means excited-state/state change; it is NOT the thermal assignment. SCF stability tests qualify the restricted singlet model, not all possible electronic states.

O3: concerted cyclic interaction. Computed two-bond evolution and the separately labeled fragment phase laboratory support cooperative six-center organization. A frontier picture alone proves neither a path nor concertedness.

R3: multiple-bond reorganization. Two new C–C indices increase while three original π bonds change and the middle diene bond gains π character; all six distances and basis-dependent indices are shown.

G3: collective geometric reorganization. Both ends of a reactive s-cis diene approach the alkene; the Hessian imaginary-mode bond derivatives test coupled local motion independently of a single orbital picture. Equal-distance constraints impose synchronicity at the scan points; symmetry of the unconstrained saddle is an independent check. Concerted does not universally mean synchronous.

1333 is inherited in the authoritative codebook and this existing event is consistent-with-convention, not relabeled candidate. Qualitative classification omits correlation, energy, normal-mode curvature, density reference, orbital gauge, numerical bond indices and reaction timing.
limitations: r2 retains 7/12 targeted fixed-r1-geometry grid/basis/RI-MP2 comparisons. These do not establish alternative-level stationary points or basis/correlation convergence. Displayed fields retain the original B3LYP/6-31G(d), grid3 model.

r2 IRC-driver convergence and independently verified endpoint connectivity are separate tests. Until all path and selected-electronic-field checks pass, the original five displayed geometries remain separately calculated constrained/saddle/minimum structures. Consult the r2 audit for actual completed and missing calculations.

Stability and the Kohn–Sham gap are diagnostics, not multireference benchmarks. No CASSCF/natural-occupation or coupled-cluster diagnostic was calculated; a restricted determinant cannot establish the absence of static correlation.

Frozen neutral fragments at product-like geometries are deliberately deformed reference states, not optimized reactants or a unique electron-transfer partition. Reported unstable references are flagged.
The uniform display grid under-resolves nuclear cores: use independent Becke quadrature and Tr(PS) for normalization. No charge transfer is integrated on the display grid.
protocol: B3LYP with PySCF default VWN-RPA correlation convention; restricted neutral singlet, 46 electrons; 6-31G(d), grid level 3, SCF energy tolerance 1e-10 Eh and orbital gradient tolerance 1e-6.

TS optimization uses full analytic nuclear gradients and an initial analytic Hessian, followed by a full final Hessian. Signed frequencies: negative numbers denote imaginary modes. Minima require no imaginary vibrational modes.
Constraints, Cartesian inputs/outputs, coefficients, Hessians and logs are downloadable. Isolated optimized reactants are distinct from the frozen s-cis fragments used for deformation density.
Fixed atom mapping C1–C6 then H7–H16; each optimized frame rigidly aligned to the TS carbon skeleton before final SCF. No density alignment or grid interpolation.
rho(current) minus rho(approach), evaluated on identical lab-frame Cartesian points after documented geometry alignment. Includes nuclear displacement, not unique electron transfer.

rho(complex) minus frozen neutral singlet butadiene and ethylene densities at that exact geometry, each B3LYP/6-31G(d) in its own basis with no ghosts. Not a counterpoise or unique charge-transfer partition.

Complex canonical orbital tracking: occupied and virtual blocks independently assigned one-to-one by maximum absolute cross-geometry AO-metric overlap (Hungarian), then sign aligned. <0.7 overlap or a larger alternative is flagged. Near-degenerate partners remain gauge dependent; no subspace continuity claim.

Raw driver status files are archived checkpoint records, not claims that jobs remain active. Only retained, independently checked outputs count as release evidence. Later unrecovered session progress is excluded.
